Description.SourceString:
The water here is filled with the torn fragments of souls, the victims of the Withering and Imaru’s boundless hunger. The waters of Noumenon have seeped in through cracks in the world and infected the great lake that once lay here.

In a forgotten time, great dragons would bathe in the lake alongside villagers and the populace would gather round to relax in the warm springs that fed the lake bed.

Grief and rage had poisoned the waters, turning it into a danger best avoided.
